global_fields.name: num_elements

global_fields.name: num_elements

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct required language combinations (each element) that the translation manager must cover. Use this to verify the target coverage — every pairing counted here must appear in the union of chosen freelancers' covered pairs.

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct topics in the course syllabus that must be covered by the selected textbooks; this defines the universe of topic identifiers the coordinator needs to cover.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of available textbook candidates the coordinator may choose from; each corresponds to one textbook (a set of topics).

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct conference services that must be covered (e.g., catering, AV, signage). This is the count of required service identifiers the selected packages must collectively supply.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of vendor packages available to choose from. Each package is an option that may cover one or more required services.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a vendor package (e.g., P1, pkg3). Use this to refer to a specific package when selecting bundles for the conference.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers for the services covered by this package (e.g., catering AV signage). Each token names a required service that this package would fulfill; the solver uses these to determine coverage across chosen packages.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct repair tasks the homeowner must cover; each listed task must be doable by at least one selected toolkit.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of different toolkits available to choose from; the objective is to pick the smallest number of these kits that together cover every repair task.

item_fields.name: set_id

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated repair-task identifiers that this toolkit can complete using only the tools inside it; if a task ID appears here, the toolkit 'covers' that task.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct ingredients required by the menu; the head chef must ensure each of these ingredients appears in at least one selected bundle.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of pre-packed ingredient bundles available to choose from; used to enumerate all candidate bundles when forming a minimal covering selection.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier (label or index) for a specific ingredient bundle; choosing this bundle supplies all ingredients listed for it. Selecting the same bundle more than once is redundant.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated ingredient identifiers contained in this bundle; these are the menu ingredients that will be covered if the bundle is chosen.

global_fields.name: num_elements

global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of themed book boxes available for selection from which the librarian may choose to cover all subjects.

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of available library candidates on the table that you can choose from to assemble the minimal toolkit.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier or name for a candidate library; used to refer to that library when selecting the minimal toolkit.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of the project features that this library implements or supplies; selecting the library covers all listed features.

global_fields.name: num_elements

global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of available exhibition modules in the catalog from which the curator can choose to cover the required themes.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of the historical themes addressed by this module; selecting this module covers all listed themes toward the exhibit's required set.

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct competencies on the skills checklist that must be covered by the selected courses. This is the size of the universe of skills the HR manager must cover.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of the competencies that this course addresses. Each identifier corresponds to an item on the skills checklist; selecting the course contributes coverage for all listed competencies.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct neighborhoods that must be served by at least one kept bus route. This is the size of the universe of neighborhoods to cover.

global_fields.name: num_sets

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a bus route (for example, a route number or code). Use this id when listing which routes are selected; each id counts the corresponding route once.

item_fields.name: elements

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of the customer preference categories that this bundle satisfies. Each identifier must correspond to one of the preference categories counted in total_preferences; a bundle covers a category if that category appears in this list.

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct research topics in the lab that must be available via subscriptions; every one of these topics must appear in at least one chosen journal.

global_fields.name: num_sets

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: A space-separated list of research topic identifiers that this journal provides access to; subscribing to this journal makes all listed topics available.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct park zones that must be monitored. This is the count of all zone identifiers the chosen sensors must collectively cover.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of available sensor units in the toolbox. Each corresponds to one candidate device you may select to monitor some zones.

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct learning objectives that must be covered by the chosen question banks (the size of the universe of objectives).

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of available question banks you may choose from; used to compare how many banks you select in a solution.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier (label or index) for a particular question bank.

item_fields.name: elements

global_fields.name: num_elements

item_fields.name: elements

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of systems that this key can open (e.g., S1 S2 S3). If this key is chosen, each listed system is considered covered.

global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct target pollinator species that must be attracted by the selected plants; every one of these species must be covered by at least one chosen variety.

item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a candidate venue/location. Use this ID when listing or selecting which venues to book.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of the scene types/settings that this venue provides. Booking the venue covers all listed scene types; these identifiers correspond to the required scene types counted in num_scene_types.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct menu dishes that must each be given at least one suitable sauce from the stocked selection.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct premade sauces available for the chef to potentially stock.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier (label or code) for a specific premade sauce option; used to refer to that sauce when choosing which to keep.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated identifiers of menu dishes that this sauce is suitable for — i.e., the dishes this sauce would cover if stocked.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct destination airports that must be reachable via the chosen hubs. This is the size of the universe of destinations the planner must cover.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of candidate hub airports the office can choose from. Each candidate hub is a possible routing hub that can serve a subset of destinations.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a candidate hub airport (e.g., an airport code or index). Use this to refer to which hub is being selected; identical identifiers refer to the same hub.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: A space-separated list of destination identifiers that are reachable through this hub. If this hub is selected, every destination listed here is considered covered (i.e., has a route via the hub).

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct workstation requirements that must be satisfied by the deployed bundles. This is the count of unique requirement IDs that need to be covered at least once.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of software bundles available to install. Each bundle is an option you may choose; the optimization goal is to install as few of these bundles as possible while covering all requirements.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a specific software bundle (e.g., name or index). Use this ID when selecting which bundles to deploy; installing the same bundle multiple times does not provide extra coverage.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated list of workstation requirement identifiers that this bundle fulfills. If a bundle is chosen, each requirement listed here is considered covered.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct neighborhoods that must have access to supplies. This is the count of all neighborhood identifiers that need to be covered by the staffed depots.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of potential supply depots you can choose from. Each depot is a candidate location that can be staffed; you want to staff as few of these as possible while covering every neighborhood.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a specific potential supply depot. Use this id to refer to that depot when planning which depots to staff.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: Space-separated neighborhood identifiers that fall within this depot's service reach. If you staff this depot, all named neighborhoods are considered served. Every neighborhood listed across depots should correspond to one of the neighborhoods counted by num_neighborhoods.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct music genres that must be given at least one scheduled slot. This counts each genre once and represents how many different genres your booked stages collectively need to cover.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The number of stage areas (booking options) available to choose from. Each stage is an option you can reserve and may host one or more genres.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific stage option you can book (e.g., a name or number). Use this to refer to that particular stage when listing or choosing reservations.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: A space-separated list of genre identifiers that this stage can host. If you reserve this stage, every genre in this list is considered covered; genres may appear on multiple stages but covering an already-covered genre gives no additional benefit.
